title: Step-by-Step Guide to Applying for a BIS License & Fee Structure

clauses.title: Finding Relevant Standard and Manakonline Submission
clauses.text:
Step 1: Identify the relevant Indian Standard (IS code) and product manual on the BIS website.
Step 2: Register on the online portal 'www.manakonline.in'. Submit Form I application with factory address, manufacturing machinery list, testing equipment calibration certificates, and raw material test reports. Pay non-refundable application fee of ₹1,000.

clauses.title: Technical Inspection and Laboratory Sample Verification
clauses.text:
Step 3: A designated BIS technical officer conducts a physical or hybrid inspection of the manufacturing premises to verify manufacturing capability, quality control personnel, in-house lab, and Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT).
Step 4: The officer draws independent test samples, seals them, and dispatches them to a BIS Central/Regional lab or NABL referral lab for conformity testing.

clauses.clause: Step 5: Grant of License & Marking Fee Structure
clauses.title: Licensing Grant and Annual Minimum Marking Fees
clauses.text: Step 5: Once lab test results indicate full conformity, BIS issues the Certificate of Manufacturing License (CM/L number). Licensee pays the annual license fee (₹1,000) plus the applicable minimum advance marking fee (ranges from ₹10,000 to ₹1,00,000 depending on product class and production volume).

clauses.clause: MSME, Startup, and Women Entrepreneur Concessions
clauses.title: 50% Fee Concession Under Government of India Policy
clauses.text:
To encourage domestic manufacturing and ease of doing business, BIS provides a special 50% concession on application fees, annual license fees, and minimum marking fees to:
1. Micro enterprises registered on Udyam portal.
2. DPIIT-recognized Startups.
3. Enterprises run by Women entrepreneurs (minimum 51% ownership). Small enterprises receive a 20% concession.
